newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian helicopter found, two dead, three survive.
newsitem.headline: Russian helicopter found, two dead, three survive.

text.p: Rescuers found two people dead on Friday and three injured but alive in the wreckage of a Russian helicopter which went missing on the far eastern peninsula of Kamchatka on Wednesday.
An Emergencies Ministry spokesman in Moscow said both crew members and one passenger survived the crash of the Mi-8 civilian transport craft. They had broken limbs and other moderate injuries.
